newsitem.title: USA: Mesa second Cameron well test successful.
newsitem.headline: Mesa second Cameron well test successful.

text.p: Mesa Inc said that its second well on the East Cameron field, off the coast of Louisiana, had completed testing at 1,680 barrels of oil per day and 8.1 million cubic feet of natural gas.

The company said in a statement that the A25 well in block 322 produced from two zones, the lower zone at 5,300 feet was at 1,120 barrels of oil per day and 880,000 cubic feet of natural gas and the upper zone at 5,000 feet at 560 barrels of oil and 7.2 million cubic feet of natural gas.
Combined with the existing A27 well, Mesa which has a 100 percent stake in the project, production capacity is 3,910 barrels of oil per day and 8.8 million cubic feet of gas.
The company is drilling five wells in total and is currently completing the third well.
Mesa said it expects all five wells to be in production by the end of the year and the drilling and completion costs will be $20 million.
Mesa is set to merge with Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co
